high_level_description: The image is a promotional poster for the movie "Lucky Baskhar." The poster features a man sitting at a desk surrounded by stacks of money and piles of documents. He is wearing a green shirt with white polka dots and glasses. His hands are clasped together on the desk, and he appears to be looking directly at the viewer with a serious expression. In the background, there is a large, detailed illustration of an Indian currency note, which adds a sense of financial importance to the scene.
